title: Bayesian Update (Beta + Bernoulli)
description:
Implement the conjugate **Beta-Bernoulli Bayesian Update**.

Given prior parameters $\alpha, \beta > 0$ for a Beta prior $\text{Beta}(\alpha, \beta)$ and a sequence of binary coin flips/trials (where $1$ denotes success and $0$ failure):
$$
\alpha_{\text{post}} = \alpha + \sum x_i, \quad \beta_{\text{post}} = \beta + \sum (1 - x_i)
$$

Compute the posterior mean $\frac{\alpha_{\text{post}}}{\alpha_{\text{post}} + \beta_{\text{post}}}$.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
The implementation solves **Bayesian Update (Beta + Bernoulli)** directly following its mathematical and algorithmic specification.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def ml_beta_bernoulli_update(alpha: float, beta: float, trials: list) -> dict:
    s = sum(int(x) for x in trials)
    f = len(trials) - s
    a_post = float(alpha) + s
    b_post = float(beta) + f
    mean = a_post / (a_post + b_post)
    return {
        "alpha_post": round(a_post, 4),
        "beta_post": round(b_post, 4),
        "posterior_mean": round(mean, 4)
    }
```
